title: Import CSV
intro: Select a Source, an account assignment, and the dates covered by the CSV.
fileFormatHelp: Use these six column names. Source and Payment References can be blank.
previewIntro: Review the extracted rows before importing them as Transactions.
importedCount: {count, plural, one {# transaction imported} other {# transactions imported}}
noCatalog: An import requires at least one Source and one Financial Account.
conflictIntro: These rows differ from existing Transactions. Keep the original values and import the other rows, or cancel the import.
canceledConflictSummary: The import was canceled with these conflicts.
coverageDates: An earlier import for {account} covers {start} through {end}. Choose a file and dates outside that period, or use exports with Source References on every row.

problems.confirmation_unavailable: The import could not be confirmed. Try again.
problems.source_side_changed: The Source side changed. Prepare a new preview before confirming.
problems.import_already_resolved: This import has already been resolved.
problems.invalid_csv: Fix the CSV errors and upload the file again.
problems.validation_failed: Check the fields and select a CSV file.
problems.invalid_origin: Reload the page and try again.
problems.file_too_large: Choose a smaller CSV file. The upload limit is 1 MiB.
problems.catalog_unavailable: The import selections are temporarily unavailable.
problems.preview_not_found: The import preview could not be found.
problems.preview_unavailable: The import preview is temporarily unavailable.
problems.cancellation_unavailable: The import could not be canceled. Try again.
problems.import_conflicts_changed: The conflicts changed since the preview. Review the updated values before confirming.
problems.import_conflicts_require_review: Review the conflicts below before confirming.
problems.import_coverage_overlap: The dates overlap an earlier import, and at least one file has rows without Source References.
problems.refresh_unavailable: A new preview could not be prepared. Try again.

reasons.unknown_source: This Source is no longer available.
reasons.unknown_financial_account: This Financial Account is no longer available.
reasons.invalid_date: Use a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
reasons.invalid_form_date: Enter a valid date in MM/DD/YYYY format.
reasons.invalid_period: Enter an end date on or after the start date.
reasons.invalid_encoding: Save the file as UTF-8 text.
reasons.invalid_header: Use the column names in the CSV format guide.
reasons.invalid_record: Check for missing or unmatched quotation marks.
reasons.invalid_column_count: Use the same number of fields as the header in this row.
reasons.no_rows: Add at least one data row after the header.
reasons.too_many_rows: Split the export into CSV files with up to 10,000 rows each.
reasons.outside_period: Use a date within the selected coverage period.
reasons.invalid_currency: Use a recognized three-letter currency code.
reasons.invalid_amount: Use a signed decimal amount with a period as the decimal separator.
reasons.invalid_precision: This amount has too many decimal places for its currency.
reasons.amount_out_of_range: This amount exceeds the supported range.
reasons.conflicting_source_reference: This Source Reference appears on rows with different values.
reasons.missing_financial_account: Enter a registered Financial Account code.

mixedHelp: Use a registered Financial Account code in the financial_account column on each row.
